results.title: [Hiring] On-camera trading content creator, fluent English, €300 to €600/month retainer + per-view bonus, Remote
results.description:
We're hiring creators to post short trading videos for Polairyx, an AI macro trading terminal. It reads world news in about 3 seconds and tells traders whether an asset leans bullish or bearish, with the reasons.

What you'd do: - Open a new Instagram or TikTok account in the trading niche, dedicated to Polairyx - Post 2 videos a day, 30 to 180 seconds, talking to camera - Normal trading

notice: Date publice, fără verificarea identității sau a bugetului. Nu reprezintă contracte confirmate. Nu s-au trimis oferte sau mesaje. Lista zilnică este publică pe GitHub.
